_comment: mon.c xkilled() 3676-3723: killing a monster adds its malign to u.ualign.record through attrib.c adjalign(), including a kill by mhitu.c passiveum() through assess_dmg() while a monster attacks a polymorphed hero. The port plans monster turns on a clone, which must not apply the planned adjustment to the live record. A Tourist (initial record 0) polymorphs into a blue jelly and creates a kobold (always hostile, chaotic, so malign 5), which dies of the cold; the attributes screen then shows the record. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
